enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Poison Blast 6: This weapon drips with vile poison, dealing 6d6 Poison damage on a successful hit, and an additional 6d6 Poison damage on a critical hit.
Giant Slayer: This weapon has a small chance to cause a struck Giant to die instantly.
Giant Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to hunt a larger foe, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Giants.
Wounding 3: This weapon saps the health from your enemies, dealing 3 Constitution damage on each hit.

Adamantine: Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.

Legendary Vulkoor's Chosen: 2 Pieces Equipped:+30 Artifact bonus to Poison Resistance+3 Artifact bonus to Sneak Attack Dice+3 Artifact bonus to Saving Throws+3 Artifact bonus to Dexterity and Constitution
